STYLE OF CAUSE: Fournier v. Canada (Attorney General)
CITATION: 2021 FCA 199
COURT: Federal Court of Appeal
DOCKET: A-88-20
DATE: 2021-11-08

Present: Chief Justice and Justices Rennie and Mactavish
Appeal from a judgment of the Federal Court dated January 15, 2020
Counsel for the appellant: J. Dubois
Counsel for the respondent: M. Kowalski

I. OVERVIEW
[1] This is an appeal from a decision of the Federal Court dismissing an application for judicial review of a decision of the Social Security Tribunal.
[2] The central issue is whether the Tribunal reasonably interpreted the phrase "severe and prolonged disability" in the Canada Pension Plan.

II. ANALYSIS
[3] The Tribunal's interpretation of its home statute is reviewed on a standard of reasonableness.
[4] The Tribunal's reasons demonstrate an internally coherent chain of analysis that is justified in relation to the facts and law.

III. DISPOSITION
[5] The appeal is dismissed.
